offense.label: Overview
offense.blurb: The big picture: how much this offense scores and moves the ball.

stats.label: EPA per play
stats.hint: Expected Points Added: how much each play changed the team's chances of scoring, on average. 0 is average; positive is good for the offense.

stats.label: Success rate
stats.hint: Share of plays that kept the offense 'on schedule' (gained enough yards for the down and distance).

stats.label: Turnovers
stats.hint: Interceptions thrown plus fumbles lost.

offense.label: Passing
offense.blurb: Throwing the ball: volume, accuracy, efficiency and protection.

stats.label: Passing yards per game
stats.hint: Net passing yards (sack yardage subtracted).

stats.label: Net yards per attempt
stats.hint: Passing yards per dropback, after subtracting yards lost to sacks.

stats.label: EPA per dropback
stats.hint: Expected Points Added: how much each play changed the team's chances of scoring, on average. 0 is average; positive is good for the offense.

offense.label: Rushing
offense.blurb: Running the ball, including quarterback scrambles.

stats.label: Stuffed rate
stats.hint: Share of designed runs stopped at or behind the line.

stats.label: EPA per designed run
stats.hint: Expected Points Added: how much each play changed the team's chances of scoring, on average. 0 is average; positive is good for the offense.

stats.label: Run success rate
stats.hint: Share of plays that kept the offense 'on schedule' (gained enough yards for the down and distance).

offense.label: Receiving
offense.blurb: Who's catching the ball and what they do after the catch.

stats.label: Avg. depth of target
stats.hint: Average depth of target: how far downfield passes travel in the air.

offense.label: 3rd Down
offense.blurb: Moving the chains on third down.

stats.label: Avg yards to go on 3rd down
stats.hint: How many yards the offense needed, on average, when it faced 3rd down. Shorter is easier: it's a sign of good early-down play.

offense.label: 4th Down
offense.blurb: Going for it, and making it.

offense.label: Red Zone
offense.blurb: Turning trips inside the 20 into touchdowns.

stats.label: Red zone TD %
stats.hint: When the offense got inside the opponent's 20-yard line, how often the drive ended in a touchdown.

stats.label: Red zone scoring % (TD or FG)
stats.hint: Red zone trips that ended in any points: a touchdown or a field goal.

stats.label: Goal-to-go TD %
stats.hint: Drives that reached 1st-and-goal (inside the 10), and how often they ended in a touchdown.

offense.label: Drives & Discipline
offense.blurb: First downs, quick punts and penalties.

stats.label: 3-and-out %
stats.hint: Share of drives that ended in a punt without a single first down.

defense.label: Overview
defense.blurb: How well this defense keeps opponents off the scoreboard.

stats.label: EPA allowed per play
stats.hint: Expected Points Added allowed per play. Lower (more negative) means the defense is better at stopping drives.

stats.label: Success rate allowed
stats.hint: Share of plays that kept the offense 'on schedule' (gained enough yards for the down and distance).

stats.label: Takeaways
stats.hint: Interceptions plus fumbles recovered from the opponent's offense.

defense.label: Pass Defense
defense.blurb: Stopping the pass: coverage and pressure on the quarterback.

stats.label: Net yards per attempt allowed
stats.hint: Passing yards per dropback, after subtracting yards lost to sacks.

stats.label: Sack rate
stats.hint: Share of opponent dropbacks that ended in a sack.

stats.label: EPA allowed per dropback
stats.hint: Expected Points Added allowed per play. Lower (more negative) means the defense is better at stopping drives.

stats.label: Stuff rate
stats.hint: Share of designed runs stopped at or behind the line.

stats.label: EPA allowed per designed run
stats.hint: Expected Points Added allowed per play. Lower (more negative) means the defense is better at stopping drives.

defense.label: 3rd Down
defense.blurb: Getting off the field on third down.

stats.label: Avg yards to go on opponents' 3rd downs
stats.hint: How many yards the offense needed, on average, when it faced 3rd down. Shorter is easier: it's a sign of good early-down play.

defense.label: 4th Down
defense.blurb: Stopping opponents when they go for it.

defense.label: Red Zone
defense.blurb: Holding opponents to field goals, or nothing, inside the 20.

stats.label: Red zone TD % allowed
stats.hint: When the offense got inside the opponent's 20-yard line, how often the drive ended in a touchdown.

stats.label: Red zone scoring % allowed (TD or FG)
stats.hint: Red zone trips that ended in any points: a touchdown or a field goal.

stats.label: Goal-to-go TD % allowed
stats.hint: Drives that reached 1st-and-goal (inside the 10), and how often they ended in a touchdown.

stats.label: Red zone trips allowed per game

defense.label: Drives & Discipline
defense.blurb: First downs allowed, quick stops and penalties.

stats.label: 3-and-out % forced
stats.hint: Share of drives that ended in a punt without a single first down.

stats.label: Punts per game
stats.hint: Fewer punts usually means the offense is moving the ball.

stats.label: Net punt average
stats.hint: Punt distance minus the return and touchback yards.
